mcodes.detail: When this function code is loaded, program execution will be stopped and the PROGRAM STOP indicator lamp will light up. At this time, the milling spindle and the turning spindle will also stop rotating.

To use this function, select [OPTIONAL STOP]. A function similar to that of M00 will be performed. At this time, the milling spindle and the turning spindle will also stop rotating. M01 will be ignored when [OPTIONAL STOP] is deselected.

When this function code is loaded, spindle rotation will be stopped and coolant injection, air blasting and the operation of the oil mist will also be stopped. Finally, the function of the NC unit will be reset to stop all operation. Except in tape operation mode, a function similar to that of M30 is performed (rewind operation).
